I changed the architecture to **autonomous quantum Tanner repair** and obtained a complete global proof candidate.

The derived bound is
\[
\epsilon_\diamond(T)\le \min\{2,\;CnT e^{-bn/2}\},
\]
below a positive, size-independent local-noise threshold. It covers **both CSS sectors, all encoded qubits, and arbitrary persistent-bath/reference correlations**. The repair rule is time independent.

The key step extends the [Gu–Pattison–Tang local potential](https://arxiv.org/html/2206.06557v1) to give proportional repair drift. A quantum exponential moment then charges the creation of dangerous backgrounds while allowing an extensive population of harmless defects. It needs neither a healthy exterior nor a stochastic replacement for coherent faults.

Three control programs passed, including exact local identities and full finite quantum dynamics with a shared bath and nonscalar no-jump evolution. The asymptotic claim rests on the written analytic proof, not those finite checks.

**Independent correctness review and novelty remain pending.** This is graph-local protection: long-range connectivity, enormous local tables, repair-reservoir synthesis and practical preparation/readout remain unresolved. It does not establish a low-dimensional device or the original Toom phase.
